results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required (if zone_identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find the zone using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES (match on domain; capture result[].id as zone_identifier; if auth error, retry with CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES).

[Optional (to prevent duplicate/unsafe writes)] [Prerequisite]: Inventory existing records using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS (paginate via result_info.total_pages; filter by type+name; capture record ids).

[Optional (if zone is missing and onboarding is needed)] [Prerequisite]: Get an account reference using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ACCOUNTS then add the zone using CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_ZONE (stop if permission is missing and request reauthorization outside tool calls).

[Required (after confirming exact DNS changes)] [Step]: Create record(s) using CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD (requires zone_identifier; if auth fails, retry with CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_CREATE_DNS_RECORD and store created record ids).

[Fallback (if create fails due to existing/conflicting record)] [Fallback]: Re-run CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS to locate the conflicting record id, then remediate via CLOUDFLARE_UPDATE_DNS_RECORD (or CLOUDFLARE_DELETE_DNS_RECORD only after explicit confirmation).
[Optional (verification)] [Next Step]: Re-list using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS to confirm final state matches the requested changes.
[Optional (if record exists but needs changes/cleanup)] [Next Step]: Update or remove records using CLOUDFLARE_UPDATE_DNS_RECORD or CLOUDFLARE_DELETE_DNS_RECORD (delete only after confirmation).
known_pitfalls: [CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES] Auth failures can present as HTTP 403 with code 9109; retry with CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES before assuming the zone is absent.
[CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS] May return error 10001 "Unable to authenticate request" with data.success=false even if the wrapper call indicates success; check data.success and errors.
[CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD] Validation gotcha: providing zone_id can fail because the schema requires zone_identifier.
[CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD] Common conflict errors: 81053 (same host exists) and 81058 (identical record exists) requiring update/delete flow.
[CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD] MX records require integer priority; otherwise error code 9100.

CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES.description: Lists, searches, sorts, and filters zones in the authenticated account. Use `page`/`per_page` to paginate; check `result_info.total_pages` in the response to iterate all pages. Does not return DNS records — extract `zone_id` from results before passing to zone-scoped tools (DNS, firewall, etc.). Only zones delegated to Cloudflare nameservers appear; empty results indicate scope or delegation constraints, not errors.

account.description: Filter zones by account ID and/or account name.

CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS.description: Tool to list and search DNS records in a Cloudflare zone. Use when you need to find existing DNS record IDs for update or delete operations, especially after a "record already exists" error during creation. Returns matching records with their IDs, names, types, content, and other properties.

name.description: Filter by exact DNS record name (FQDN). Use this to find records matching a specific hostname.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Start at 1.

type.description: Filter by DNS record type. Specify the exact record type to narrow results.

match.description: Filter matching logic: 'all' requires all filters to match (AND logic), 'any' requires at least one filter to match (OR logic). Defaults to 'all'.

content.description: Filter by exact DNS record content/value. Use this to find records pointing to a specific IP or target.

proxied.description: Filter by proxy status. Set to true for proxied records, false for DNS-only records.

zone_id.description: Zone identifier (UUID) to list DNS records from

per_page.description: Number of records per page (1-5000000). Defaults to 100. Use lower values for faster responses.

name_contains.description: Filter by DNS record names containing this substring. Useful for partial matching.

comment_contains.description: Filter by comments containing this substring.

content_contains.description: Filter by DNS record content containing this substring.

CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD.description: Tool to create a new DNS record within a specific zone. Requires write privileges and makes live changes to the zone. Use after obtaining the zone ID via CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES to programmatically add DNS entries.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; minimum 1. Use 1 for automatic TTL

data.description: Additional data object for record types like SRV, LOC, or CAA

name.description: DNS record name (e.g., example.com or www.example.com)

tags.description: List of tags to associate with the record

comment.description: Human-readable comment for the DNS record

content.description: DNS record content (e.g., IP for A records)

proxied.description: Whether the record is receiving Cloudflare performance and security benefits

priority.description: Priority for MX, SRV, and URI records; required for those types

zone_identifier.description: Zone identifier (UUID) where the DNS record will be created

CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES.description: Tool to list, search, sort, and filter Cloudflare zones. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of zones available to the authenticated user.

name.description: A domain name; supports the same operators as account.name.

match.description: Whether to match any or all search requirements (default: all).

account.name.description: Account name; supports operators: equal (default), not_equal, starts_with, ends_with, contains, starts_with_case_sensitive, ends_with_case_sensitive, contains_case_sensitive.
